mapper.select: /* CastConfigMapper.retrieveCategoryList */ SELECT A.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID AS FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, NVL(A.ATRB_GROUP_NM, ' ') AS ATRB_GROUP_NM, CASE WHEN A.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = '001' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS BASE_YN, NVL(A.CFMTN_YN, 'N') AS CFMTN_YN, NVL(A.GROUP_PRCS_STTS_CD, ' ') AS GROUP_PRCS_STTS_CD, NVL(TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), ' ') AS FRST_REG_DT FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP A WHERE 1 = 1 AND NVL(A.DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY CASE WHEN A.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID = '001' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, A.FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID
mapper.insert: /* CastConfigMapper.insertCategory */ INSERT INTO PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_FIX_ATRB_GROUP ( FIX_ATRB_GROUP_ID, ATRB_GROUP_NM, CFMTN_YN, GROUP_PRCS_STTS_CD, DEL_YN, FRST_RGTR_ID, FRST_RGTR_IP_ADDR, FRST_REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{fixAtrbGroupId}, #{atrbGroupNm}, 'N', '01', 'N', #{loginUserId}, #{loginIpAddr}, TO_TIMESTAMP(#{frstRegDt}, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )
